name: claudetto
description: Adds a lean output style, six role agents, and a status line command. Adds hooks that check edits and `git` calls, bound the context of subagents, and check Markdown line breaks and drift.

decide.title: Second Opinion
decide.description: Use `off` for no second opinion, `claude` for a small Claude model, or `jev` for Jev (it needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, and the question goes to the TypeSafe API). Claude can use the second opinion only when this is not `off`.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Use `handoff` to write a handoff file in place of the compaction summary, or `built-in` for the compaction of Claude Code.

aiPolicy.title: AI Policy Gate
aiPolicy.description: When on, claudetto reads the AI policy of each repository that is not yours before Claude pushes or writes to GitHub there, and blocks those actions when the policy forbids AI tools. Local edits and commits stay allowed.

judge.title: Turn Judge
judge.description: On: a model checks the end of each turn that has a reply, and blocks a claim that no call shows, a step that it gives the user with no block, and a change of position with no new evidence. Each check is one Sonnet call of at most about 2,500 tokens.
